messages:
Casey (Marketing): Heads-up: steering toward a compact webinar for platform teams — 'Inference launch playbook: benchmarks, buyer signals, and operational runbooks'. Can we lock and assign abstracts + rehearsal slots?
Nora (Content): Sounds good. I'll produce a 30s landing blurb + 90s speaker brief and a 1-slide TL;DR. Posting drafts in ~2h.
Jin (Solutions): I'll own demo infra. Plan: non-prod endpoint, a 60s live call limit, and precomputed fallback. Will upload curl snippet.
Amir (Growth): Promo cadence: announce 12 days out, benchmark teaser 6 days, technical deep-dive 3 days, last chance 24h. Paid social departs at 6d.
Casey (Marketing): Rehearsal windows: Tue 09:00 PT tech check (audio/screenshare) + Thu 09:00 PT dress. Please confirm availability.
Nora (Content): Thu dress only for me but I can join a short tech check earlier if needed.
Jin (Solutions): Both slots good.
Amir (Growth): I'll join Tue tech check, Thu for final 30min.
StudioBot: Event created: "Inference launch playbook"  Tech check Tue 2024-09-10 09:00 PT, Dress Thu 2024-09-12 09:00 PT. Calendar invites sent.
Casey (Marketing): Run-of-show (first pass):
00:00-00:30 intro + goal (Casey)
00:30-04:00 buyer signals + procurement triggers (Amir)
04:00-10:00 benchmark methodology + what moves buyers (Nora + Jin)
10:00-18:00 demo: compare configs A vs B (Jin live + fallback)
18:00-20:00 TL;DR + slides-to-share + CTA (Casey)
20:00-30:00 moderated Q&A
30:00-60:00 internal debrief + follow-ups
Jin (Solutions): Demo rules: live call <60s. Fallback file hosted on CDN. curl snippet: ```curl -sS -X POST $TEST_ENDPOINT -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}' -m 5```
Amir (Growth): Registration form fields request: Role (dropdown), Main inference pain, Budget band (optional), Consent to be contacted. We'll route roles to SDR queues.
Nora (Content): Draft landing blurb (30s): "Join Redwood Inference for a tactical playbook on inference launches — real benchmarks, buyer signals, and the runbook teams use to ship LLM features without surprises." Feedback?
Casey (Marketing): Nice. Add: "Recommended for platform, infra, and product teams."
Nora (Content): Done. Uploading copy + speaker bullets to Drive: https://drive.google.com/fake-link-launch (v1).
Casey (Marketing): Action items: Nora finalize abstracts + TL;DR by EOD tomorrow; Jin provision test key + upload fallback; Amir queue promo calendar & routing; Casey will send invites and reserve recording VM. Mark done here when complete.
Jin (Solutions): Test key provisioned and fallback uploaded: https://cdn.redwood.fake/launch-fallback.png
Amir (Growth): Promo calendar queued; ad copy awaiting final abstracts.
Nora (Content): Abstracts + speaker bullets uploaded (v1).
Casey (Marketing): Great. I'll assemble slides and share review link later today. Closing thread unless blockers. :white_check_mark:
